questions: What is the capital of Canada?

questions: What is the capital of Brazil?
extra: Brasilia replaced Rio de Janeiro as the capital in 1960.

questions: What is the capital of Turkey?
extra: Ankara became the capital in 1923, replacing Istanbul.

questions: What is the capital of Switzerland?
extra: Bern is called the federal city rather than the capital in Swiss law.

questions: What is the capital of New Zealand?
extra: Wellington is the southernmost national capital in the world.

questions: What is the capital of Myanmar?
extra: Naypyidaw replaced Yangon as the capital in 2006.

questions: What is the capital of Nigeria?
extra: Abuja replaced Lagos as the capital in 1991.

questions: What is the capital of Kazakhstan?
extra: The capital moved from Almaty to Astana in 1997.

questions: What is the capital of Morocco?
extra: Casablanca is the largest city, but Rabat is the capital.

questions: What is the capital of Vietnam?
extra: Hanoi has been the capital since the country was reunified in 1976.

questions: What is the capital of Pakistan?
extra: Islamabad replaced Karachi as the capital in the 1960s.

questions: What is the capital of Bangladesh?
extra: Dhaka is one of the most densely populated cities in the world.

questions: What is the official capital of Tanzania?
extra: Dar es Salaam is the largest city, but Dodoma is the official capital.

questions: What is the capital of Nepal?
extra: Kathmandu lies in a valley of the same name in the Himalayas.

questions: What is the currency of Japan?
extra: The yen is the third most traded currency in the foreign exchange market.

questions: What is the currency of India?
extra: The rupee symbol is issued by the Reserve Bank of India.

questions: What is the currency of Switzerland?
extra: Switzerland is not in the eurozone and keeps its own franc.

questions: What is the currency of Sweden?
extra: Sweden uses the krona; Norway and Denmark use the krone.

questions: What is the currency of Poland?
extra: Poland is in the EU but has kept the zloty.

questions: What is the currency of Thailand?
extra: The baht is divided into 100 satang.

questions: What is the currency of South Africa?
extra: The rand is named after the Witwatersrand gold fields.

questions: What is the currency of Mexico?
extra: The Mexican peso uses the dollar-style $ sign.

questions: What is the currency of South Korea?
extra: North Korea also has a won, but it is a separate currency.

questions: What is the currency of Vietnam?
extra: Dong is written with a stroke through the d in Vietnamese.

questions: What is the currency of Turkey?
extra: The Turkish lira is subdivided into 100 kurus.

questions: What is the currency of Israel?
extra: The new shekel replaced the old shekel in 1985.

questions: What is the currency of the Czech Republic?
extra: The Czech Republic is in the EU but has kept the koruna.

questions: What is the currency of Brazil?
extra: The real was introduced in 1994 to end hyperinflation.

questions: What is the currency of Malaysia?
extra: Ringgit means jagged in Malay, after the serrated edge of old silver coins.
